Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Area Rug, 5' 3" x 7' 7", Off White
Materials: Polypropylene
Add energy to your home decor with this unique contemporary-style rug. With a muted color palette that enhances the geometric pattern, this rug will provide the perfect finishing touch to your interior design. 5' 3" x 7' 7" 100% polypropylene Machine-made for durability and excellent value. Deep 1.25" pile makes this rug comforting and luxurious.
